mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ainer_workspace (id, tenant_id, name, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{name}, #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT workspace.id, workspace.tenant_id, workspace.name, workspace.version, workspace.created_at, workspace.updated_at FROM ainer_workspace workspace INNER JOIN ainer_workspace_member member ON member.tenant_id = workspace.tenant_id AND member.workspace_id = workspace.id WHERE workspace.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND member.subject_id = #{subjectId} AND member.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY workspace.created_at DESC, workspace.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ainer_workspace workspace INNER JOIN ainer_workspace_member member ON member.tenant_id = workspace.tenant_id AND member.workspace_id = workspace.id WHERE workspace.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND member.subject_id = #{subjectId} AND member.status = 'ACTIVE'
